logo_override.validation_detail: png 871x253, probed via webfetch -> 'Image fetched successfully' (HTTP 200 + image content type); full-colour wordmark, crimson circular mark + dark navy 'ERS' lettering, dark elements on a light card
logo_override._award: ERS Visiting Mid-Career Investigator Travel (VISIT) Grant

notes: Awarding body is the European Respiratory Society, so the ERS corporate mark is correct (not the programme's own artwork). The shard's official_source_url /education-and-professional-development/ers-visit-grant returned a webfetch 'Decode error' and could not be read, so I went to the awarding body's homepage as the brief's step 1 permits. The ERS homepage (WordPress + Yoast) publishes a JSON-LD Organization node whose 'logo' ImageObject gives contentUrl https://www.ersnet.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/ERS-logo-full.png with width 871 / height 253 and caption 'European Respiratory Society - ERS'. That is a real probeable file, not a guessed path. Probed it: webfetch returned 'Image fetched successfully', confirming HTTP 200 and an image content type (the brief's rule 4 test). It is the full-colour horizontal lockup rather than the bare favicons (/wp-content/themes/ers-theme/assets/icons/favicon-*.png, safari-pinned-tab.svg), which the brief says to prefer over; the favicons were not used. Rule 3 checked: the mark is crimson #C8102E-ish plus dark navy lettering, so nothing is white-on-transparent. Served from www.ersnet.org, the shard host itself.
